input.overview: Dungeon Door Defender runs as continuous tower-defense waves. Hit enemies with the ball, use lit hero and mana shots for support, and complete both side target banks for an arrow volley. Standups and lane completions earn gold; between waves, spend it on repairs and upgrades before later enemies overwhelm the castle door.
input.simpleOverview: Keep the castle door alive through each wave. Hit enemies, shoot lit hero and mana shots, and complete the side target banks for arrows. Between waves, spend gold on repairs and upgrades.
input.summary: Enemy waves begin automatically. Hit enemies with the ball, use the lit hero and mana shots, and complete the side target banks for an arrow volley. Spend gold between waves to repair and upgrade the castle door.

quickInfo.name: Door health
quickInfo.summary: Enemies that reach the door and every drained ball reduce its health; the game ends at zero.

quickInfo.name: Heroes and magic
quickInfo.summary: Lit hero shots summon defenders, while lit mana shots add magic effects to the ball.

quickInfo.name: Arrow volley
quickInfo.summary: Complete the side target banks to send arrows across the screen and damage enemies in their path.

quickInfo.name: Shop
quickInfo.summary: Spend standup- and lane-earned gold between waves on repairs and upgrades.

steps.text: When a wave begins, keep the ball moving through on-screen enemies so they cannot reach and damage the castle door.
Shoot the lit hero shots to summon defenders and the lit mana shots to give the ball stronger magic effects.
Complete both side target banks to fire an arrow volley through the enemies crossing the lower screen.
Protect the ball as well as the door: a drain damages door health, and the game ends only when that health reaches zero.
Hit standups and complete lanes during each wave to collect gold for the next shop visit.
Between waves, repair urgent door damage first, then buy ball-damage, hero, or other upgrades that match your reliable shots.
Expect the shop inventory to change and repeated purchases to cost more; reassess after every cleared wave.

playfieldReferences.label: Enemy wave area
playfieldReferences.description: The tracked P3 screen where ball contact damages advancing enemies.

playfieldReferences.label: Arrow-volley targets
playfieldReferences.description: The two side banks that fire arrows when completed.

playfieldReferences.label: Module-specific support shots
playfieldReferences.description: Lit upper-playfield shots assigned to heroes and mana on the installed module.

cautions.issue: The game runs on either the Heist or The Princess Bride module.
cautions.response: Select Dungeon Door Defender on one of those modules and follow its lit hero, mana, and gold shots; their physical locations differ between layouts.

cautions.issue: Standard multiplayer is disabled because a wave does not stop when a ball drains.
cautions.response: Play one continuous defense run at a time and hand off only after the door reaches zero health.
